about: Leonida Trophy Guide data. Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Every guide is written fresh for this entry, in its own words, and names its sources. The game is not released yet: where a detail is not public, the guide says so instead of inventing it.
hiddenNote: The kit starter does not publish which trophies are hidden on PlayStation, so the hidden flags here are this guide's estimate: story trophies and trophies whose official description is deliberately vague are marked hidden, 26 of 55. The official list reports 28 hidden; the gap is left as it is rather than forcing flags to match, because the remaining descriptions all state their objective plainly. The flags will be checked against the live listings after release.

roadmap.title: Opening moves
roadmap.summary: Play the opening mission and Chapter 1. Pick up the early moment trophies as you go and get a feel for Leonida.

roadmap.title: Chapters 2 and 3
roadmap.summary: Push the story through Chapters 2 and 3. Try every activity type once and start the repeatable feats that add up over time.

roadmap.title: Chapter 4 and the strands
roadmap.summary: Finish Chapter 4 and play the character mission strands and side activities through. Explore new areas as they open up.

roadmap.title: Finale and endgame
roadmap.summary: Complete the final mission, finish the stranger strands, and clear the remaining story-linked and endgame trophies.

roadmap.title: Cleanup and the platinum
roadmap.summary: Sweep up collectibles, counts and 100% completion. The platinum unlocks once every other trophy is earned.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task here beyond finishing everything else in this guide. Work through the roadmap in order: clear the story first, then sweep up collectibles, activities and cleanup trophies. Exophase and PSNProfiles both list this as the single platinum on the game's 55-trophy list.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and this unlocks as part of the story. It is the first story trophy on the list, so no preparation or side content is needed before it. Exophase and PSNProfiles agree it is a bronze story trophy tied to that mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through the story until Chapter 1 is complete; the trophy pops when the chapter ends. Nothing here can be missed, since chapter completion follows the main story line. Both Exophase and PSNProfiles list it as a bronze chapter trophy.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the story. Like the other chapter trophies it unlocks through normal story progress, so just keep following the main missions. Exophase and PSNProfiles list it as bronze.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Keep playing the main story missions in order and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. Listed as bronze by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. This is the last numbered chapter trophy before the finale, and it unlocks through story progress alone. Exophase and PSNProfiles list it as bronze.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story to earn this gold trophy. It marks the end of the main story, so it comes naturally at the close of a full playthrough. Exophase and PSNProfiles both list it as one of the game's two gold trophies. The final mission's name and details are not public yet, so follow the story to its conclusion.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies unlock by playing the main story, so this one arrives on its own as you progress. Exophase and PSNProfiles list it as bronze.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. This is a story mission trophy, so no side work is required; play the main missions in order. Bronze on both Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks through story progress. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. A story mission trophy; it pops when the mission is done. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission trophy that unlocks in the course of the main story. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. This late-story mission trophy unlocks through normal story play. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion across the game. That means finishing the story, the stranger and character mission strands, activities, collectibles and the other checklists the game tracks; the full in-game checklist is not public yet, so use the game's own completion screen once it is available and cross-check against Exophase and PSNProfiles, which both list this as the second gold trophy.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's driving and traversal tricks; rack them up steadily across free roam rather than grinding them all at once, since they add up over a full playthrough. The exact stunt list and how each one is counted are not public yet, so track progress in game and check Exophase and PSNProfiles for the community's stunt list after release. Silver.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The listings count 9 activity types; sample one of each, races, fishing, arcade games and the rest, and the trophy pops. The full list of the 9 types is not public yet, so try every activity you come across. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Head to the shooting range and work through every challenge until each one holds a gold medal; expect the later challenges to need practice and steady aim. The challenge list and scoring details are not public yet. Silver on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location, 14 in total according to the trophy listings. Learn each course's line before racing it for the win, and clear them as you open up new areas. Exact locations are not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter races across Leonida and win each one once; different events count, so spread your wins rather than repeating one race. The race roster is not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find the fishing challenge against Cal and out-fish him; fishing challenges reward patience and the right spot, and details of the contest are not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Visit an arcade, pick a game and play it through to completion. Which arcade games count and where the arcades are is not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission strand runs through several missions; keep taking his jobs until the strand ends with its final mission. The strand's mission order is not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's strand of missions until its last one is done. Details of the strand are not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play through Billy's missions until the strand concludes. The strand's details are not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Look for stranger encounters around the state and play each strand to its end; eight completed strands earn the silver. Where the strangers are and which strands count is not public yet. Silver on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand through to its last mission. The strand's details are not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Play Tyrone's missions until the strand's final mission is done. Details are not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida, 18 spots according to the trophy listings. Visit each meditation spot and meditate there; keep a checklist as you go so none is missed. The spot locations are not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take on Bret's hunting request and track down the one unique animal he wants; hunting details and the animal's location are not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find cards around Leonida and finish three full sets; cards are scattered, so collect as you explore rather than leaving them all to the end. Card locations are not public yet. Silver on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK It interaction is found at spots across the state; use it at 100 different locations. Where those spots are is not public yet, so use them whenever you pass one. Silver on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game tracks challenges across many categories; work through them as you play and the count climbs steadily. The challenge list is not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build up a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. The exact escape mechanics are not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner alongside, keeping the wanted level alive between robberies; plan a route between nearby shops and keep moving. Shop locations and robbery details are not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or encounter 100 different vehicles across Leonida; variety counts, so try everything you find rather than sticking to one ride. The vehicle list is not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a fight with at least five enemies close together and drop all five before it ends; pick a crowded encounter and have a strong weapon ready. The exact Combat Focus mechanics are not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave Vice City International Airport in an unconventional way; the description is deliberately vague, and the exact method is not public yet, so this is one to check against Exophase and PSNProfiles guides after release. Bronze on both listings.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description gives no objective, so the exact requirement is not public yet; the Rhino is the series' military tank, and the trophy likely involves one, but do not guess at the method. Check Exophase and PSNProfiles after release. Bronze on both listings.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan a quiet approach, avoid cameras and guards, and get out without ever being spotted; if you are detected, the attempt fails. Store locations and stealth details are not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away clean after each one; plan escapes in advance, since the getaway is part of the requirement. Vault locations are not public yet. Silver on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck, rob it and escape afterwards; the escape matters as much as the robbery. Truck routes and details are not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida, 52 areas according to the trophy listings. Visit every area of the state; use the in-game map to spot places you have not been yet. The area list is not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang, 9 gangs according to the trophy listings. Find and rob one illegal operation per gang across the state. Gang territories and operation locations are not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find the spot with the view and have a cocktail there. The exact spot is not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle out through a showroom in the series' classic fashion; the nod is to the old games, and the exact showroom and method are not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Visit that bowling alley and bowl; the name points to a story-flavoured moment, and the exact requirement is not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague and the exact requirement is not public yet, so check Exophase and PSNProfiles after release rather than guessing. Bronze on both listings.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. This trophy tracks the choices you make, and the listings note PlayStation tracks a count toward 500. It is the one trophy on this list that can plausibly be missed: choices in a playthrough can lock in, so keep a save before major decisions and make choices deliberately across the story. The exact choice list is not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt, but the exact requirement is not public yet; check Exophase and PSNProfiles after release. Bronze on both listings.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description points to witnessing something strange, but the exact trigger is not public yet; check Exophase and PSNProfiles after release. Bronze on both listings.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving, knock someone down with a melee attack: a drive-by with a melee weapon rather than a gun. The exact mechanics are not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills via your contacts until the total reaches $250,000; it adds up over time, so launder regularly rather than saving it all for the end. Contact and laundering details are not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in total at shops of any kind; it counts cumulatively, so normal shopping across a playthrough contributes. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties, 8 in total according to the trophy listings. Buy every garage property on the market; save up, since property is expensive. Locations and prices are not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the Scooter Bros app to register ten vehicles. App and registration details are not public yet. Bronze on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
